question: A young _______ is called a joey.
solution:
The correct answer is __**kangaroo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **young ones** of the **kangaroo** are called **Joey**.
 
• The **group of kangaroo** is known as **mob, troop, or court**.
 
• Kangaroos have a **special pouch** called **a marsupium **for carrying their babies.
 
• **Kangaroo is** the national animal of **Australia**.
 
• **Kangaroos **are **Marsupials** belonging to the animal family **Macropodidae**.
 
• **Kangaroos **are **characterized** by** powerful hind legs, a long, strong tail, **and **small front legs**.
